definitions.explanation: Describing something of small size. A casual/cute alternative to 小さい.

examples.japanese: ちっちゃい{頃|ころ}の{写真|しゃしん}がある。
examples.english: I have photos from when I was little.

examples.japanese: この{虫|むし}ちっちゃくて{可愛|かわい}い。
examples.english: This bug is tiny and cute.

notes:
ちっちゃい is a casual/cute contraction of {小|ちい}さい. The gemination (っ) adds emphasis and a childlike or affectionate nuance.

REGISTER:
This is casual/colloquial language with a slightly cute nuance. Use {小|ちい}さい in polite or formal contexts.

CONJUGATION:
As an i-adjective: ちっちゃくない (negative), ちっちゃかった (past), ちっちゃく (adverb form).

VARIATION:
ちっこい is another casual variant with similar meaning.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ちっちゃい{頃|ころ}: when (I/you/they) was little
- ちっちゃい{子|こ}: a little child
